scoring_justification: The eight constants are deterministic given the known undamaged parameters and explicit formulas; the checker independently recomputes them and compares with relative tolerance 1e-6, which is the strongest feasible tier.

hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact parameters used in the paper to generate the numerical evaluation; they are not invented.
